svg.aria-label: John B Joseph. Co-founder and CPTO, Purplecop Security. Your AI agents act in seconds. Your audit evidence shouldn't take four weeks. I build both halves: AI security that decides what an agent is allowed to do before it does it, and the compliance software that proves your controls actually work. 12,000+ people practise GRC in the lab I built (Google Analytics · Nov 2026). 34 countries they log in from (Google Analytics · Oct 2026). 32,530 people follow along on LinkedIn (LinkedIn analytics · Nov 2026). 400+ controls across 9 frameworks to practise on (GRC Practice Lab · Nov 2026).
